document.title: Dark Neumorphic Smart Home Dashboard — Design Specification

source_image.notes: Approximate visual measurements and colors. Recreate responsively; do not treat screenshot coordinates as fixed production dimensions.

document.purpose: Visual, component and interaction specification for recreating the supplied dashboard.

design_system.style_name: Dark Soft-Neumorphism / Ambient Smart Home UI
visual_character: Soft raised and recessed neumorphic surfaces
Large rounded cards and circular wells

typography.font_family: Inter, SF Pro Display, or similar modern geometric sans-serif

shape_language.rule: Prefer large continuous corner radii; avoid sharp edges and hard outlines.

surface_treatment.card_fill: Subtle gradient from a slightly lighter upper-left to darker lower-right.
surface_treatment.raised: Broad soft upper-left highlight plus deeper lower-right shadow.
surface_treatment.recessed: Dark inset well with faint inner upper-left highlight and lower-right inner shadow.
surface_treatment.borders: Usually none; if needed use a very low-opacity cool-grey border.

lighting.violet_glow: Diffuse violet bloom around active toggles, slider thumbs, lamp icon and thermostat arc.
lighting.cyan_glow: Soft cyan bloom around air-conditioner and shield icons and small status dots.
lighting.ambient_shadow: Large blurred dark shadow beneath cards to lift them from the page.
lighting.edge_highlight: Very subtle pale blue-grey highlight on upper-left edges.
lighting.intensity: Glow should be visible but diffuse; reserve the strongest illumination for the thermostat arc.

regions.description: Full-width rounded hero. Large circular thermostat in upper-middle; indoor temperature and air-quality labels to the left; quick-action circles at the edges; room selector and cooling status centered at bottom.

responsive_behavior.narrow: Use two columns only while cards remain readable; otherwise stack cards in one column. Keep the hero first.
responsive_behavior.wide: Constrain and center the dashboard; increase spacing proportionally instead of stretching controls.
responsive_behavior.safe_area: Respect device safe areas and allow vertical scrolling.

layers: Inner circular face with subtle violet rim
Partial violet arc around upper-right/right circumference
Bright circular thumb at arc endpoint
visual.ticks: Numerous fine low-contrast radial marks; selected major divisions slightly longer.

interaction.drag: Drag thumb around the permitted arc to change target temperature.
interaction.tap: Tap arc to move thumb to nearest position.
interaction.feedback: Update numeric value and animate arc smoothly.
interaction.accessibility: Expose a numeric temperature control and announce its value.

motion.arc_and_thumb: 180–280 ms ease-out for discrete changes; direct tracking while dragging.
motion.glow: Static or very subtle breathing pulse.

visual.temperature_label: Small muted two-line label: Indoor Temperature.
visual.air_quality: Cyan leaf icon plus Good Air Quality on two lines.

items.visual: Raised dark circular button with pale icon.

interaction.plus: Increase target temperature by one configured step.
interaction.minus: Decrease target temperature by one configured step.

components.name: Room selector
components.interaction: Open room menu; changing room updates thermostat and device states.

components.name: Cooling active status
components.interaction: Status indicator; optionally opens HVAC details.

visual.icon: Pendant lamp inside circular dark icon well with violet glow.
visual.toggle: Pill toggle, ON; violet thumb at right.
visual.title: Smart Lights
visual.subtitle: 3 of 5 On
visual.slider: Sun icon, violet filled track, dark remainder, circular violet thumb, 70% value.

interaction.toggle: Enable or disable the light group.
interaction.icon: Open detailed lighting or scene controls.

motion.lamp_glow: Fade glow in when enabled and down when disabled.

visual.icon: Cyan AC line icon in circular dark well with cyan ambient glow.
visual.toggle: Pill toggle, ON, violet thumb at right.
visual.title: Air Conditioner
visual.subtitle: Cooling • 22°C

visual.icon: Music-note icon in circular dark well with violet glow.
visual.toggle: Pill toggle, ON, violet thumb at right.
visual.title: Music System
visual.subtitle: Playing • Chill Mix
visual.slider: Speaker icon, violet filled track, dark remainder, circular violet thumb, 60% value.

interaction.toggle: Enable/disable system or start/pause playback according to product logic.

motion.icon_glow: Optional gentle violet pulse while playing.

components.name: Security

visual.icon: Cyan shield outline in circular dark well with cyan glow.
visual.navigation: Circular raised button with right chevron.
visual.title: Security

interaction.door_lock: Open lock status and permitted controls.
interaction.motion: Open sensor status and event history.

motion.status: Steady cyan dot when secure; use a distinct warning state for alerts.

components.safety: For real security controls, distinguish locked, unlocked, unknown and offline states; never rely on color alone.

components.name: Floating expand affordance
components.interaction: Expand dashboard or enter fullscreen if supported.
components.note: May be a viewer/screenshot overlay rather than part of the dashboard itself; include only if it belongs to the target product.

accessibility: Use semantic buttons, switches and sliders rather than decorative controls.
Provide accessible labels for icon-only buttons.
Expose toggle state and slider values to assistive technology.
Maintain readable contrast for secondary labels.
Do not communicate active, warning or error states by color alone.
Support reduced-motion preferences and visible keyboard focus.
quality_checklist: Cards have soft depth without hard borders.
Thermostat remains the dominant visual element.
Violet is mainly for active controls and adjustable values.
Cyan is mainly for environmental, climate and security indicators.
Labels are compact and consistently aligned.
Sliders and toggles clearly show current state.
Lower cards remain reachable by scrolling.
Layout remains legible on narrower and wider screens.
